No public arbitrary-recipient payment exists. Zero-unit sends perform no callback; failed ETH calls revert.

	- maxObservationGap != 0 && side != 0 && old.identity == identity && old.side == side && old.firstSeen != 0 && old.firstSeen <= old.lastSeen && old.lastSeen <= block.timestamp && block.timestamp - old.lastSeen <= maxObservationGap && block.timestamp - old.firstSeen >= duration (src/ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.sol#180-182)
findings.rationale: Intentional observation identity/side and strict boundary comparisons. Same-block repeats cannot create elapsed time; future or stale records reset. Ordinary ready still gates hard cooldown. Emergency16 evaluates live condition and matching samples without implicitly selecting bit1. New early-cooldown, reference re-entry and expiry regressions exercise this distinction.
findings.review_scope: Unique exact prior fingerprint and every description-referenced source LF-byte-identical to that prior review
